name: Verb Reel
tagline: "I can ___" — every verb performs itself, with a hard colour switch on each word.
description: Vertical self-promo style for motion designers, studios and feature tours. A fixed "I CAN" header sits top-left while each verb acts out its own meaning — SQUASH squashes, STRETCH stretches, OVERSHOOT overshoots, BLUR blurs, LOOP loops — on hard cuts between orange, cream and black, ending on an electric-blue name card.

display.usage: Uppercase verbs 230–330px; font-stretch 62–100% chosen per verb so it fills the width

transitions: hard cut on every word with a full background colour switch
no crossfades; the verb's own motion is the transition
textAnimations: OVERSHOOT: letters drop from above / below with back.out(4–5)
BLUR: slides in skewed with filter blur 40px → 0, ghost copy trails
LOOP: three marquee rows scroll in alternating directions

rhythm.notes: One verb per second, cut exactly on the word. Intro stack ~1.3s, end card ~1.1s.

guide:
- Keep the "I CAN" header fixed top-left in every scene; only the verb and the background change.
- Pick verbs that can act out their meaning and animate exactly that (squash, stretch, overshoot, blur, loop, spin, split, bounce).
- Rotate backgrounds orange #ff5a1f → cream #efeae0 → black #111 on each cut; the verb is black on light, orange on black.
- Use Archivo's width axis so each verb fills ~85% of the frame width; transform scale for the gag, not font size.
- Set initial distorted states with gsap.set, not CSS transforms.
- End on a blue #3b4cff card: name, one line of what you do and when you're available, and a URL.
